gates.name: 0.1 Startup phrase spoken and install target pinned: asset name,
gates.description: Startup phrase spoken and install target pinned: asset name, source path, install method (symlink or copy), and every destination directory declared before anything is linked or copied
gates.command: Session log line 'INSTALL: <asset> via <symlink|copy> to <dest...>'; destination list saved to .rig/install/destinations.txt

gates.description: Verification doctrine loaded: can-go-red proof is mandatory — a gate that only ever returns green is theater and blocks certification; every certification event is recorded to rig-memory-os
gates.command: Session preamble contains the phrases 'can-go-red' and 'install_certified'

gates.name: 0.3 RIG coordinate stated before any destination is touched
gates.description: RIG coordinate stated before any destination is touched
gates.command: Session log line of form 'COORD: L3-L4 x D1-D4 x A1 x IQRSQPI'

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_installverify(asset, install_method, red_pro
gates.description: Harness tuple H_installverify(asset, install_method, red_proof, seal, fleet_record) declared with all five components named
gates.command: Session log contains the tuple declaration verbatim

gates.name: 1.1 Source asset pinned by content hash: sha256 of every source
gates.description: Source asset pinned by content hash: sha256 of every source file is computed before install; the source parses/compiles in place (YAML safe_load for harnesses, SKILL.md section check for skills)
gates.command: sha256sum over source files saved to .rig/install/source-hashes.txt; python3 parse assertion exits 0; both recorded

gates.name: 1.2 Source carries its own proof bundle: the asset's done-test e
gates.description: Source carries its own proof bundle: the asset's done-test exists and currently passes against the source location (pre-install green baseline)
gates.command: bash -c <asset done-test> exit code 0 with output saved to .rig/install/pre-green.txt

gates.name: 2.1 Install executed per declared method: symlink installs creat
gates.description: Install executed per declared method: symlink installs create links that resolve (readlink succeeds, target == source path); copy installs produce byte-identical destinations (sha256 match against 1.1 hashes)
gates.command: For symlink: readlink <dest> output equals source path, saved to .rig/install/link-check.txt. For copy: sha256sum of destinations matches source-hashes.txt line-for-line, saved to .rig/install/copy-check.txt

gates.name: 2.2 No clobber without record: any pre-existing file at a destin
gates.description: No clobber without record: any pre-existing file at a destination was either absent, identical, or archived before overwrite; surprise overwrites are forbidden
gates.command: Pre-install snapshot of destination directory listing vs post-install; overwritten paths each have an archive entry in .rig/install/clobber-archive/; python3 set assertion on the diff

gates.name: 2.3 Discoverability check: the installed asset is reachable thro
gates.description: Discoverability check: the installed asset is reachable through the intended discovery surface — catalog row updated, or directory listing/glob over the install root finds it
gates.command: python3 -c globbing the install root for the asset name AND (if cataloged) json-loading the catalog asserting the row exists and points at the installed path; output in .rig/install/discovery.txt

gates.name: 3.1 Post-install GREEN: the asset's done-test executes against t
gates.description: Post-install GREEN: the asset's done-test executes against the INSTALLED location and exits 0
gates.command: bash -c <done-test, cwd=installed location> exit code 0; output saved to .rig/install/post-green.txt

gates.name: 3.2 Post-install RED proof: a planted break is applied to a COPY
gates.description: Post-install RED proof: a planted break is applied to a COPY of the installed asset (or a temporary sabotage that is then reverted) and the same done-test MUST exit non-zero with an informative message; the red output and the revert are both verified
gates.command: Recorded triple in .rig/install/red-proof.txt: sabotage description | bash exit code (!= 0) with stderr captured | post-revert re-run exit code 0; a done-test that stays green under sabotage blocks certification

gates.name: 3.3 Substrate liveness: the MathExec substrate passes self-test
gates.description: Substrate liveness: the MathExec substrate passes self-test this session, anchoring that planted-failure machinery is itself functional on this machine
gates.command: python3 ~/Developer/needle-haystack/artifacts/meta/mathexec_substrate.py self-test exits 0 with 'SELF-TEST PASS' saved to .rig/install/mathexec.txt

gates.name: 4.1 Install record sealed: {name, path, sha256, green_exit, red_
gates.description: Install record sealed: {name, path, sha256, green_exit, red_exit, red_message} written as the certification record and sealed via meta-proof-sealer (digest chained to predecessor)
gates.command: .rig/install/install-record.json contains all six fields; seal verification recomputes the digest from disk bytes and matches; seal output in .rig/install/seal.txt

gates.name: 4.2 Certification event recorded to rig-memory-os: install_certi
gates.description: Certification event recorded to rig-memory-os: install_certified on pass or install_blocked on failure, including the red-path exit code as evidence
gates.command: rig-memory-os memory.record_event(kind="install_certified"|"install_blocked", name=<asset>, red_exit=<code>, seal_digest=<hash>) returns an event id recalled byte-for-byte; round-trip in .rig/install/memory-roundtrip.txt

gates.name: 4.3 Fleet manifest consistency: if the install targets multiple
gates.description: Fleet manifest consistency: if the install targets multiple destinations, every destination verifies independently; the install manifest (install_manifest.json or session equivalent) lists only destinations that individually passed 2.1-3.2
gates.command: python3 -c asserting every manifest destination has a corresponding per-destination evidence file; per-destination verdicts in .rig/install/fleet-verdicts.txt

gates.name: 4.4 Repeat-offender escalation: an asset whose red-path check ha
gates.description: Repeat-offender escalation: an asset whose red-path check has failed in prior sessions (per rig-memory-os recall) is flagged and proposed as an untrusted gate
gates.command: rig-memory-os recall of prior install_blocked events for this asset name; if count > 0, memory.propose_memory(content="untrusted_gate", evidence_refs=[<event ids>]) acknowledged; recall output and (conditional) proposal ack in .rig/install/recall.txt

preconditions.startup_phrase: I am the install verifier. An install I cannot break on purpose is an install I cannot trust.
preconditions.bms_bias: A1 exclusively — install verification is pure evidence work; A2/A3 forbidden (no prose substitutes for a red-path exit code); A4 forbidden — this session verifies global installs, it never performs outward fleet pushes without Gate-D

self_improvement.update_trigger: the same asset fails red-path 2+ times → it is added to the untrusted-gate list and its done-test is escalated for rewrite; install destinations that repeatedly drift out of sync get a fleet-verdicts tightening in gate 4.3

success_conditions: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates, zero stop events
Installed asset verified at every destination: links resolve or copies hash-match, discovery surface finds it
Done-test GREEN post-install and provably RED under planted sabotage with revert confirmed
Install record sealed with all six fields; digest verified from disk bytes
install_certified / install_blocked event recorded to rig-memory-os and round-trip verified

failure_states: notes: stop on 3.2: a done-test that cannot go red under sabotage means the install's safety net is fictional — certification is refused, install_blocked is recorded, and the asset is quarantined until its done-test is rewritten; the sabotage MUST be reverted before the session halts
stop gate(s) 3.2: session halts; human Gate-D approval required before any continuation or outward action
halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 3.1, 3.3, 4.1, 4.2: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 4.3, 4.4: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver

final_rule: Green is worthless until red is demonstrated.
Hash the source, verify the destination, seal the record.
Sabotage, watch it fail, revert, watch it pass — in that order, every time.
Every install-verification session leaves the system stronger than it found it.
